items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Benson – on that tour, George Benson, Bob James, Ron Carter, Jack Dejohnette... I remember it, because – Hank Crawford and Fred would get into it on the bus.

ctx.x: His son is now a big, big drummer, Rasheed [Nasheed] Waits. Who chose the personnel? Did you have that? Or was that something that was also negotiated?

You know what? I’m sure – Waits played on my band on it, and I think Bob James is on there – I’m sure Creed – we all came together on that, because Creed was very instrumental – he’s very particular about anybody going into Rudy Van Gelder’s
studio. They didn’t want anybody that’s anybody. People had to have a certain personality, certain sound.
